2610.10042.title: Learning to Accumulate Knowledge with Mutual Information
2610.10042.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can improve their performance by reusing knowledge distilled from past interactions. However, curating new experiences into a knowledge bank that becomes more useful as it grows remains challenging. Effective knowledge accumulation should limit redundant overlap among entries and ensure that new knowledge contributes beyond what the bank already provides. Yet training a curator with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on standalone task success can reinforce general guidance even when it duplicates existing knowledge. Therefore, we propose Knowledge Weaver, a reinforcement learning framework that trains a language model to curate reusable knowledge from agent trajectories. We couple feedback inspired by token-wise mutual information (MI) with marginal success rewards to guide knowledge accumulation. Together, these signals encourage the curator to preserve distinct information from experience and produce entries that improve task success when added to existing knowledge. Standalone success rewards also favor entries that are useful on their own. On ALFWorld and WebShop, Knowledge Weaver achieves mean success rates of 54.0\% and 42.0\% with k=10 retrieved entries, exceeding GRPO by 16.9 and 18.7 percentage points, respectively. Its knowledge banks also outperform the evaluated prompt-based and established banks, including human-written banks, in overall ALFWorld success rate and WebShop score with the executor frozen. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver.
2610.10042.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理可以透過重用過去互動中提煉的知識來提高其性能。<lb/>然而，將新的經驗整理成一個隨著增長而變得更有用的知識庫仍然是一項挑戰。<lb/>有效的知識積累應該限制條目之間的冗餘重疊，並確保新知識超越知識庫已提供的內容。<lb/>然而，使用群體相對政策優化（GRPO）訓練策展者以獨立任務成功為目標，即使重複現有知識，也可能強化一般指導。<lb/>因此，我們提出了知識編織者（Knowledge Weaver），這是一個強化學習框架，旨在訓練語言模型從代理的軌跡中策劃可重用的知識。<lb/>我們將受啟發於逐字互信息（MI）的反饋與邊際成功獎勵結合，以指導知識的積累。<lb/>這些信號共同鼓勵策展者保留來自經驗的不同信息，並生成在添加到現有知識時能提高任務成功的條目。<lb/>獨立成功獎勵也偏好那些獨立有用的條目。<lb/>在ALFWorld和WebShop上，知識編織者在k=10檢索條目下實現了54.0\%和42.0\%的平均成功率，分別超過GRPO 16.9和18.7個百分點。<lb/>其知識庫在整體ALFWorld成功率和WebShop分數上也超越了評估的基於提示的和既有的知識庫，包括人類撰寫的知識庫，當執行者被凍結時。<lb/>我們的代碼庫可在https://github.com/LaoKuiZe/Knowledge-Weaver獲得。
